notes:
New
- Sweet Email. Connect Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail or your own mail server with an app password, then
  read, organise and send your mail in AppSweet. Mark as read, star, move, Block and Not spam work on
  many conversations at once, with Undo. Write with attachments, save attachments to Files, and
  read recent Inbox mail offline. Show one account's mail or All Inboxes.
- Share Docs and Files with people outside your organisation, by link or only with the people you
  add. A link can have a password and an end date. People you share a document with can comment on
  it, and their comments show in the document in AppSweet.
- Organisation Owners and Admins set the sharing rules in Settings › Sharing, and see and stop
  everything shared outside the organisation.
- A search bar on Today finds Docs, Todos, Files and Goals by their words and their meaning.
- Sweetheart can search the web and read web pages, citing them as footnotes. Turn web research on
  or off per conversation. The searches and pages it read show under its answer.
- Mark text in Docs with a marker colour.
- Broadcast can post to Instagram as a Post, a Reel or a Story.

Improved
- Long Sweetheart runs check their result against the goal before they end, and keep working instead
  of stopping after a refused step or an empty answer.
- Local models are more reliable in long runs and subagents, and say why when a model cannot load.
- Sweetheart keeps facts about you in About you and saves fewer duplicate memories.

Important
- This version needs your AppSweet server to be updated too. Once a server is updated, older
  desktop apps must update before they can connect to it again.
